contexto.colecao: Anki novo, só o Baralho padrão

json.front:
Она приходила вчера, но меня не было дома.
▶
json.back:
pri-ha-DI-la
приходила ▶
приходи́ла
To come or to arrive on foot; here it is the habitual or repeated past, "she used to come".
при- – arrival, movement towards a place
ход – the idea of walking, going
-и-л- – verb stem and past tense; imperfective aspect
-а – feminine singular: she (3rd person, past tense)
Мама приходила домой поздно.
